name: deslop-writing
description: Remove AI writing patterns, preserve meaning, and refine your voice in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

interface.shortDescription: Natural writing. Your meaning and voice intact.
interface.longDescription: Edit English and Brazilian Portuguese text to remove repetitive phrasing, inflated language, and mechanical structure. Preserve facts, quotations, uncertainty, and the author's intent. Includes human-ai for English and humanizar for Brazilian Portuguese. Runs with the current model without external services or account setup.
defaultPrompt: Edit this email to sound natural while preserving every fact and commitment.
Remove repetitive AI phrasing from this draft and keep my voice.
Revise this Brazilian Portuguese text without changing its meaning.
